events.verdict: Randle (MIN) raises his off-arm toward Kleber's (DAL) vertical left arm and the contact prior to Randle passing the ball is marginal.
Kleber (DAL) extends his hands into Edwards' (MIN) back and affects his ability to get to the rebound.
Edwards (MIN) places his off-arm against Washington (DAL) and releases from the contact.
Lively II (DAL) cleanly deflects the ball as Edwards (MIN) makes the pass.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) and Thompson (DAL) engage and disengage as Thompson moves to set the pick.
Lively II (DAL) establishes a screening position in Alexander-Walker's (MIN) path and does not initiate illegal contact during the pick.
Irving (DAL) jumps vertically and absorbs the contact with Edwards (MIN), and the incidental contact causes him to turn in mid-air.
Prior to the violation, Washington (DAL) releases the throw-in within five seconds.
DiVincenzo (MIN) legally contests Thompson's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Grimes (DAL) commits a take foul on Randle (MIN).
Irving (DAL) establishes a screening position in Alexander-Walker's (MIN) path and does not deliver illegal contact.

Edwards (MIN) and Grimes (DAL) come together at the same spot as they each pursue the loose ball and the contact is incidental. Grimes is off-balance as he controls the loose ball and there is no illegal contact by Edwards during the shot attempt.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) legally contests Kleber's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
